title: Grateful Dead Live at O'Keefe Center on 1967-08-04
lineage: CDR > EAC(secure) > Cool Edit(remove pops) > CDWav (retrack) > mkwact(seekable)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a raw 1967 show featuring a soaring New Potato Caboose and an intense Viola Lee Blues jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean, well‑balanced soundboard that some listeners note runs slightly fast but remains highly listenable. Musically the band is in a developmental phase, delivering flashes of brilliance—especially on New Potato Caboose—while the long Viola Lee Blues>Feedback stretch showcases early psychedelic jamming. Overall the performance feels energetic and historically interesting despite occasional uneven moments.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4‑5) and praise for both the recording fidelity and standout songs push the rating into the good‑to‑great range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, well‑balanced soundboard; a few listeners note the tape runs slightly fast but no major dropouts or muffiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only two songs (Viola Lee > Feedback jam and New Potato) make up a short, high‑energy set that captures the band’s early jamming evolution.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Flashes of brilliance; occasional stuck moments but generally in the zone.
band_member_comments.Phil: Great performance, strong bass foundation throughout.
band_member_comments.Bob: Nice vocal on New Potato Caboose.
